title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: About to take off...you got anything going on?
Nothing. No one likes our players.
Make them like your players
The Yankees are trading guys I’ve never heard of for $1.5 mill in bonus pool. Nobody needs a starter? Lefty reliever?

No one has even called me on Liriano and Fiers is not sexy enough it seems. Iggy has no team to go to as Milwaukee and Philadelphia went with better hitters. So no where else for him to go. No one offering squat for Greene but we have two more years of control with him and try again in the winter or next season.
Martin possibly but we would not get back anything We like. So we wait
Yep. Brutal
Yep. Buyers market and the market is flooded with good players available
PIT scout asked me about Iglesias a few days back, if he was a bad dude
I hope you told him he is a good dude because he has a poor reputation out there.
I said he’s fine. Been playing better since Gardy scared him straight
PIT has not called me on him
This is in confidence so be cool.
Doesn’t there come a point when you call them
Yeah I know. I appreciate the update.

I have been in constant contact with about 12 clubs But like I said. Phillies and Brewers got their guys and that ends where there was a place for Iggy.  PIrates have no interest in him. I have discussed Fiers with several clubs but none feel he can make a difference. Greene the return is poor right now so we can wait till winter or next year. What more do you want me to tell you. Sometimes people are unrealistic and or just don’t understand how trades and these kind of things work.
If we do anything at all it will come as more as a salary dump and there is not a whole lot to dump at this point.
Meaning like Fiers or Martin
